GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Re perf, rdr advised after winning last start at Acton on 20 June 2025, the mare had been stepped up in distance for today which was thought would benefit the mare. He added however that his mount never travelled comfortably given today’s genuine speed and despite pleasing in its work in the lead up to today’s race, had performed disappointingly. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.
